air bags of automobiles during a collision. We would like to build an electromechanical system in 
such a way that when the acceleration exceeds a certain limit, one of the electrical parameters of 
the system such as the voltage at a certain point of the circuit will exceed a threshold and the air 
bag will be activated as a result.
